Phase lower bound has three positive rational degree-four tensor Bernstein certificates on enlarged sign boxes, with minima 247/81,344/729,2. For two-high region F_* is positive quadratic in last radius, with discriminant complement D=AC-B² having 81 nonnegative degree-eight rational Bernstein coefficients on [0,7/20]^2, only one corner zero. Independent exact rational polynomial construction reproduced all these certificates and unique equality radius triple (1,1,1/4). Phase restoration yields (η,η,-η/4), normalized ratio 7/10. Coefficient nonnegativity proves continuum claim, not finite sampling.
